commits.edited_message: rar5: Detect 32 bit size_t overflows and reduce owner name stack use
commits.patch:
diff --git a/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c b/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c
index f9a2327..779e64c 100644
--- a/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c
+++ b/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c
@@ -158,7 +158,7 @@ enum REDIR_TYPE {
 #define	OWNER_GROUP_NAME	0x02
 #define	OWNER_USER_UID		0x04
 #define	OWNER_GROUP_GID		0x08
-#define	OWNER_MAXNAMELEN	256
+#define	OWNER_MAXNAMELEN	128
 
 #define	SFX_MAX_READAHEAD	(1024 * 512)

commits.edited_message: rar5: Adjust read_var/read_var_sized return values and preserve owner names

coupling: The first commit reduces OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, which sizes the stack buffer and originally also caps both owner-name copies. The later commit uses the former 255-byte owner-name limit in both copy sites while the buffer remains 128 bytes. Either edit applied by itself leaves the copy bounded by a 256-byte buffer or by the 128-byte limit; only their combination makes a valid 200-byte owner name overflow the stack buffer. A repair has to reconcile the allocation and both copy limits across the two commits.
